verdict.rationale: Recurly hosts a live llms.txt at docs.recurly.com/llms.txt (confirmed via probe HTTP 200) plus multiple product-specific llms.txt files (Engage, RevRec), and also documents agent-oriented tooling via the Compass MCP server for AI dev tools like Claude Desktop/Cursor. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume these llms.txt files in practice.
